Title: Rishabh's Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Ajay - 43 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Rishabh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rishabh opens his umbrella.]

Rishabh: "That was fun!"

[Rishabh puts on his raincoat.]

Rishabh (surprised): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Rishabh stands by the road. Anjali and Ajay stand near him.]

Rishabh: "Dad, look over here."

[Father rides the bicycle with Rishabh sitting on the carrier behind him.]

Anjali (surprised): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
